text: タケシが　あいてを　さがしてる　…　こっちに　こい！

structure.jp: タケシが　あいてを　さがしてる　…
structure.en: Brock is looking for an opponent...

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says an action is going on right now; てる is the shortened spoken form. さがしてる = 'is looking for'.

patterns.name: 命令形
patterns.explanation: こい is the blunt order form of くる, used by someone talking roughly. こっちに　こい = 'come over here!'.
